battle.name: 1991年伊拉克起義
battle.brief: 1991年伊拉克起義發生在海灣戰爭尾聲，伊拉克南部什葉派居民與退伍軍人反抗薩達姆政權，起義據點涉及納杰夫、卡爾巴拉與納西里亞等地，遭政府軍武力鎮壓。美軍當時已配備加特林機槍（Gatling gun），可由車載或固定式槍位提供近程火力。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 加特林機槍是美國陸軍用於近程持續壓制的旋轉多管武器，可裝於車載與固定槍位，憑高射速及彈幕形成打擊敵方步兵與輕型車輛的火力。

countries: 一九九一年一月十七日美英等國主導的聯軍開始對伊拉克境內軍用目標進行空襲，伊拉克南部隨即爆發反政府武裝起義。此次交戰的一方是控制中央政權的伊拉克政府、伊拉克人民軍、共和國衛隊及內部安全部隊；另一方則由南部起義者、倒戈的伊拉克軍人，以及北部的伊拉克庫德武裝構成。主要戰場包括納西里耶與其希吉爾區、巴士拉、卡爾巴拉、納杰夫、阿馬拉，以及北方的蘇萊曼尼亞、埃爾比勒、基爾庫克和摩蘇爾接近地帶。南部與北部起義共享軍隊崩解和政治危機，卻沒有建立統一指揮系統。聯軍不是直接參與鎮壓起義的一方，也沒有向起義武裝提供成建制補給；科威特境內的戰事只是影響伊拉克軍隊部署的外部背景。
countriesEn: On 17 January 1991, the US- and British-led coalition began striking Iraqi military targets, and armed anti-government uprisings broke out in southern Iraq. One side consisted of the Iraqi government, Iraqi Army, Republican Guard and Internal Security Forces. The other comprised southern insurgents, mutinous Iraqi servicemen and Kurdish armed groups in the north. The principal battlegrounds included Nasiriyah and its al-Hijr district, Basra, Karbala, Najaf and Amarah, as well as Sulaymaniyah, Erbil, Kirkuk and the approaches to Mosul in the north. The southern and northern risings shared the disintegration of the army and a common political crisis, but they never formed a unified command structure. The coalition was not directly suppressing the uprising and supplied no organized aid to the insurgents. The fighting in Kuwait was instead an external pressure that altered Iraqi force deployments.
people: 伊拉克總統兼最高軍事指揮者薩達姆・侯賽因掌握鎮壓起義的中央決策權，但南部沒有產生一 名得到所有武裝承認的戰役指揮官。實際帶頭者包括納西里耶第51機械化師的部分軍官與士兵、地方游擊核心及臨時接納他們的原有部隊；一九九一年一月十九日，該師倒戈並把大量裝備交給起義者，成為南部局勢突然惡化的關鍵。共和國衛隊特種部隊、裝甲部隊及內部安全部隊隨後受命反攻，阿里・哈桑・馬吉德等政府高級軍官在中央指揮鏈中協調南線行動。北方由伊拉克庫德斯坦愛國聯盟與庫爾德斯坦民主黨的武裝組織分別作戰，賈拉勒・塔拉巴尼與馬蘇德・巴爾扎尼是政治領袖，但各地方部隊的戰術指揮並不統一。這種政治層級與戰術指揮分離的局面，使政府能封鎖消息，也讓起義者難以形成共同攻勢。
peopleEn: Iraqi President and supreme military commander Saddam Hussein made the central decisions to suppress the uprising, but the south never produced a single commander accepted by all armed groups. Those who took the lead included officers and soldiers from the 51st Mechanized Division at Nasiriyah, local insurgent nuclei and former army units that admitted the defectors. On 19 January 1991, part of that division mutinied and transferred a large quantity of equipment to the insurgents, sharply worsening the southern situation. Republican Guard Special Forces, armored formations and Internal Security Forces were then ordered to counterattack, while senior regime officers such as Ali Hassan al-Majid coordinated southern operations through the central chain of command. In the north, armed organizations of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan and the Kurdistan Democratic Party fought with Jalal Talabani and Masoud Barzani serving as political leaders, although local tactical command remained divided. This separation between political hierarchy and battlefield control allowed the government to suppress information while preventing the insurgents from mounting a common offensive.
kits: 起義者的武器主要來自伊拉克軍原有裝備，而非另建一套制式軍隊。納西里耶第51機械化師倉庫被奪後，部分T-62與T-72M1主力戰車、BMP-1步兵戰鬥車、BTR-60裝甲運兵車、Ural-375卡車、122毫米D-30榴彈炮及炮組被武裝分子接收；伊拉克軍原有的T-55坦克與M109A1 155毫米自行榴彈炮也構成可能的火力來源。南部技術車多以Toyota Land Cruiser FJ-60或Toyota Hilux皮卡為底盤，架設PKM通用機槍或ZU-23-2雙管23毫米機炮；RPG-7則是對付裝甲車與據點的主要反裝甲武器。北方武裝使用AK-47、AKM、PKM、DShK 12.7毫米重機槍及RPG-7，並取得卡車與軍用燃料。作戰消耗包括7.62×39毫米、12.7×108毫米、23×152毫米及122毫米炮彈，另有152毫米與155毫米榴彈炮彈。輪胎、蓄電池、備用履帶、潤滑油與柴油供應，往往比子彈更早中斷持續作戰。
kitsEn: The insurgents drew most of their weapons from existing Iraqi stocks rather than building a separate standardized force. After the stores of the 51st Mechanized Division at Nasiriyah were seized, some T-62 and T-72M1 main battle tanks, BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60 armored personnel carriers, Ural-375 trucks, 122 mm D-30 howitzers and their crews passed to armed groups. Existing Iraqi T-55 tanks and M109A1 155 mm self-propelled howitzers also provided possible fire support. Southern technicals commonly used Toyota Land Cruiser FJ-60 or Toyota Hilux pickup chassis fitted with PKM general-purpose machine guns or ZU-23-2 twin 23 mm automatic cannons, while RPG-7 launchers remained the principal anti-armor and anti-position weapons. Northern forces used AK-47 and AKM rifles, PKM and DShK 12.7 mm heavy machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, and captured trucks and military fuel. Operational consumption included 7.62×39 mm, 12.7×108 mm, 23×152 mm and 122 mm ammunition, along with 152 mm and 155 mm howitzer rounds. Tires, batteries, spare tracks, lubricants and diesel frequently interrupted sustained operations sooner than ammunition supplies.
tactics: 南部起義首先利用聯軍空襲造成的指揮混亂、兵源分散與武器庫防守空隙。倒戈部隊和地方武裝同時攻取營區、彈藥庫、橋樑與主要路口，以路障切斷政府增援，並以RPG-7伏擊沿公路接近的T-62或T-72M1裝甲縱隊。少量坦克進入城區後提供直射火力，卻因視野、轉向和後援不足而容易受RPG及反坦克火 力牽制。政府的反擊則把砲兵、步兵和裝甲車分開運用：先以榴彈炮破壞路障、壓制街區，再由步兵清理通往機場、兵營與倉庫的道路，最後以裝甲車封鎖已恢復的路口。北方起義採取多點推進，庫德武裝利用山地道路維持聯絡，並依次向蘇萊曼尼亞、埃爾比勒及基爾庫克方向攻取省會、營區和補給點。忠于政府的部隊則沿摩蘇爾至埃爾比勒、基爾庫克至蘇萊曼尼亞的公路軸線集中兵力，以裝甲先鋒封路、步兵占領高地和砲兵控制郊外地帶，再逐個奪回城鎮。聯軍空襲沒有直接替起義方提供戰術掩護，這使兩條起義戰線各自形成。
tacticsEn: The southern rising initially exploited the confusion in command, dispersal of troops and gaps in depot security caused by coalition air attacks. Mutinous units and local armed groups struck barracks, ammunition depots, bridges and major junctions simultaneously, blocked government reinforcements with barricades and ambushed T-62 or T-72M1 armored columns along the roads with RPG-7 launchers. A small number of tanks entered the cities to provide direct fire, but restricted visibility, limited maneuverability and inadequate support left them vulnerable to RPG fire and anti-tank engagements. Government counterattacks separated artillery, infantry and armor: field howitzers broke barricades and suppressed urban sectors, infantry cleared routes toward airfields, barracks and warehouses, and armored vehicles sealed the restored junctions. In the north, the insurgents advanced on several axes, used mountain roads to maintain contact and moved against provincial capitals, barracks and supply points in the direction of Sulaymaniyah, Erbil and Kirkuk. Loyal government forces concentrated along the Mosul-Erbil and Kirkuk-Sulaymaniyah road axes, used armored spearheads to close routes, placed infantry on high ground and artillery outside the towns, and then recovered the cities one at a time. Coalition air power did not provide direct tactical cover for the insurgents, leaving the two uprising fronts to develop separately.
data: 可核實的時間線從一九九一年一月十七日開始，當日聯軍展開大規模空襲；一月中旬，納西里耶、巴士拉及附近軍區已出現武裝衝突。一月十九日，第51機械化師部分官兵倒戈，起義者取得該師武器與車輛。從一月二十日至二十三日，衝突沿納西里耶至巴士拉、卡爾巴拉至納杰夫及阿馬拉至巴士拉的交通走廊擴展，希吉爾區營房、納西里耶機場周邊與軍械庫成為反覆爭奪的地點。一月二十四日至月底，共和國衛隊增援部隊與原留守軍進入南線，政府逐步收復若干路口、機場和兵營，但南部仍有成建制起義力量活動。一月二十九日，聯軍在科威特發動地面攻勢，伊拉克政府不得不把部分裝甲與機械化部隊從國內調往前線，北方與南部的防線因而更加空虛。二月初至十日前後，北方武裝先後控制蘇萊曼尼亞、埃爾比勒和基爾庫克；二月中旬至下旬，忠于政府的部隊沿主要公路反攻，奪回部分道路與郊區控制線。二月二十四日至二十六日，聯軍在科威特完成主要地面進攻；二月二十八日停火之際，北線反攻仍在進行，零星抵抗延續至三月初。
dataEn: The verifiable timeline begins on 17 January 1991, when the coalition launched its large air campaign; armed clashes were already present around Nasiriyah, Basra and nearby military districts by mid-January. On 19 January, part of the 51st Mechanized Division mutinied, and the insurgents obtained the division's weapons and vehicles. From 20 to 23 January, fighting spread along the Nasiriyah-Basra, Karbala-Najaf and Amarah-Basra corridors, with the al-Hijr barracks, the approaches to Nasiriyah airfield and the ammunition depots repeatedly contested. Between 24 January and the end of the month, Republican Guard reinforcements and units still holding government loyalty entered the southern front and gradually recovered roads, airfields and barracks, although organized insurgent formations remained active. On 29 January, the coalition began its ground offensive in Kuwait. The Iraqi government had to transfer armored and mechanized formations from inside Iraq to that front, further thinning its northern and southern defenses. Between the beginning and roughly the tenth of February, northern forces took Sulaymaniyah, Erbil and Kirkuk in succession; from mid-to-late February, loyal units counterattacked along the principal roads and recovered parts of the approaches and surrounding districts. From 24 to 26 February, the coalition completed its principal ground operations in Kuwait. The northern counterattack was still underway when the ceasefire took effect on 28 February, and isolated resistance continued into early March.
cause: 起義的直接誘因是聯軍空襲、伊拉克政府與軍隊之間的信任崩解，以及一九九一年一月十九日第51機械化師部分官兵倒戈。南部武裝因能直接取得完整裝甲、砲兵和運輸裝備而迅速擴張，北方則趁伊拉克部隊被抽往科威特、防區指揮與後勤聯絡減弱時發動。較深層的原因包括一九八零至一九八八年兩伊戰爭造成的軍隊疲勞、裝備與薪資供應不足，以及入侵科威特後的制裁和財政壓力。執政的復興黨長期把什葉派地區排除在中央權力之外，北方庫德族要求擴大自治與政治權力，這些長期衝突在軍隊士氣低落和中央軍事失靈時迅速浮現。聯軍打擊削弱了政府對全國部隊的控制，卻沒有提供一套能取代中央政府的軍事安排；因此，起義者獲得的是武器與暫時的戰術主動權，而不是可持續的統一指揮體系。
causeEn: The immediate triggers were the coalition air campaign, the breakdown of trust between the Iraqi government and its armed forces, and the mutiny of part of the 51st Mechanized Division on 19 January 1991. Southern armed groups expanded quickly because they could capture intact armor, artillery and transport equipment, while northern forces rose as Iraqi units were transferred to Kuwait and command and logistics links in the north weakened. Deeper causes included the fatigue of a military worn down by the 1980-1988 Iran-Iraq War, shortages of equipment and military pay, and the financial pressure and sanctions that followed the invasion of Kuwait. The Ba'ath government had long excluded Shi'a districts from central power, while Kurdish demands for greater autonomy and political representation remained unresolved. These accumulated conflicts surfaced when military morale declined and central control failed. Coalition strikes weakened the government's command of national forces without supplying a military alternative, giving the insurgents weapons and temporary tactical initiative but not a sustainable unified command structure.
impact: 南部起義最直接的戰術影響，是把第51機械化師的完整或部分裝備轉入地方武裝手中，使原本缺乏重武器的攻擊者能以T-62、T-72M1、BMP-1和自行榴彈炮投入公路與城市戰。政府必須把共和國衛隊、內安部隊與裝甲部隊分散配置，同時應付南部城市、北方省會和科威特前線，任何一線的延誤都會牽動其餘兩線。聯軍沒有把伊拉克內部起義納入撤軍談判或公開的軍事援助，這讓忠於政府的部隊得以集中兵力完成反攻，也使聯軍作戰仍停留在迫使伊拉克撤出科威特的既定範圍。起義還顯示，首都與地方之間的指揮鏈並非牢不可破，裝甲部隊的忠誠、取決於糧餉、燃料、物資補給與政治信任。北方武裝在短時間內奪取多個省會，暴露伊拉克北部在主力外調後的脆弱；部分起義骨幹其後在境外建立政治與武裝聯絡，並在1992年參與伊拉克民族大會的籌組，但起義本身未能形成足以攻入巴格達並推翻政府的統一政治軍。
impactEn: The most immediate tactical effect of the southern rising was the transfer of intact or partial stocks from the 51st Mechanized Division to local armed groups. Insurgents who had lacked heavy weapons were able to commit T-62 and T-72M1 tanks, BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles and self-propelled artillery to road and urban combat. The government had to disperse Republican Guard, Internal Security and armored formations among the southern cities, the northern provincial capitals and the Kuwait front, so delay in any one theater affected the other two. The coalition did not incorporate the Iraqi uprising into the withdrawal negotiations or a public relief program, allowing loyal forces to concentrate on the counterattack and leaving coalition policy focused on forcing Iraqi withdrawal from Kuwait. The rising also demonstrated that the chain of command between the capital and the provinces was not unbreakable, and that armored-unit loyalty depended on pay, fuel, supply and political confidence. The temporary seizure of several northern provincial capitals exposed the north's weakness after major formations were moved away; some insurgent leaders later established political and armed contacts abroad and took part in organizing the Iraqi National Congress in 1992, but the uprising itself never became a unified political force capable of entering Baghdad and overthrowing the government.
result: 到一九九一年二月底，忠于政府的部隊已依靠裝甲縱隊、步兵封鎖與砲兵火力，逐漸奪回納西里耶、卡爾巴拉、納杰夫、阿馬拉一線的關鍵道路、機場和軍區，北方的埃爾比勒與基爾庫克也重新落入政府軍控制，蘇萊曼尼亞周邊的主要戰鬥則在月底至三月初收束。南部起義武裝失去城市、武器庫與有組織的指揮鏈，部分被打散或解除武裝，北部各派也未能維持跨城鎮的協同攻勢。薩達姆・侯賽因政府仍掌握首都、正式軍隊與大部分重型裝備，起義因此未能改變伊拉克政權；伊拉克人民軍也沒有因聯軍停火而被全面解除武裝。聯軍在科威特取得的成果是迫使伊拉克軍撤出科威特，而不是介入並解決伊拉克內部鬥爭。從戰役結果看，起義失敗的關鍵是起義方雖取得武器和初期主動權，卻缺少穩定後勤、統一指揮及能持續攻擊首都的戰略目標；政府方則在保住裝甲部隊與中央權力後，得以逐線奪回失地。
resultEn: By the end of February 1991, loyal government forces, employing armored columns, infantry blockades and artillery fire, had gradually recovered key roads, airfields and military districts along the Nasiriyah, Karbala, Najaf and Amarah axis. Erbil and Kirkuk in the north again came under government control, while the principal fighting around Sulaymaniyah continued from late February into early March. Southern insurgent groups lost their cities, weapons depots and organized command network; some were dispersed or disarmed, while the northern factions could not maintain a coordinated offensive across several towns. Saddam Hussein's government retained the capital, the regular army and most of its heavy equipment, so the uprising did not change the Iraqi regime. Nor was the Iraqi Army comprehensively disarmed when the coalition ceasefire took effect. The coalition had forced Iraqi troops out of Kuwait, but it had not intervened to decide the internal struggle in Iraq. The decisive weakness of the insurgents was that weapons and temporary initiative did not produce stable logistics, unified command or a strategic objective capable of sustaining an attack on the capital. The government, having preserved its armored forces and central authority, recovered the lost positions one front at a time.
